title: ‘Dhakai Jamdani the Pride’
intro: Learn the process of naturally dyed yarms and weaving the simplest of Jamdani motifs. Come and create memories with a member of the your family through a series of workshops at House of Annetta as part of the High Streets Heritage Action Zone Cultural Programme.

sections.text: Appreciate and understand the UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage of Dhakai Jamdani.
The works created will be part of the final exhibition.
